subject: The one mistake 90% of users make on match day
preview_text: Our top 1% of users do this one thing differently. It changes everything about how they win.
body_paragraphs: I was watching the Manchester derby with a friend who uses Predictify. He checked his phone once, smirked, and said 'City wins 3-1.' I laughed. He was right. I asked him how he knew. He said 'I don't just check scores. I set up my workflow like the pros.'

Turns out, our most successful users don't just open the app on Saturday morning. They treat it like a tactical dashboard. They set alerts for specific confidence scores (85%+ only). They cross-reference the deep player stats with the head-to-head history *before* the lineups are even announced. They're not guessing. They're building a data fortress around their decisions.

The secret is in the 'My Insights' tab. The top 1% don't just browse predictions. They save the 3-5 matches per week that meet their strict data criteria. They build a weekly watchlist based on AI confidence + defensive strength metrics. This turns random browsing into a targeted strike mission.

Open Predictify right now. Go to 'My Insights' and save your first high-confidence match. Build your watchlist before the weekend fixtures drop. P.S. The users who do this are 3x more likely to spot the value bets everyone else misses. They also tend to upgrade to Premium during the 3-day trial to get unlimited access to this workflow.
